个性化学习伴侣

Personalized Learning Companion

支持多模态输入的智能学习助手，通过苏格拉底提问法让学生深入思考，培养自主学习能力。

Intelligent learning assistant supporting multi-modal input, guiding students to think deeply through the Socratic method, and cultivating self-learning abilities.

设计目标
Design Goals

  • 多模态输入支持（文本/文档/图片）
    Multi-modal input support (text/documents/images)
  • RAG知识库领域专业知识（ID: 7566844865104330804）
    RAG knowledge base for domain expertise (ID: 7566844865104330804)
  • 双轨服务：直接回答 / 引导探索
    Dual-track service: Direct answers / Guided exploration
  • 苏格拉底法多轮引导
    Socratic method multi-round guidance

关键组件
Key Components

组件 Component 功能 Function
链接读取插件 LinkReaderPlugin 解析PDF/Word/网页 Parse PDF/Word/Web pages
OCR插件 OCR Plugin 从图片中提取文本 Extract text from images
RAG检索 RAG Retrieval 课程知识库查询 Course knowledge base query
引导循环 Guidance Loop 生成问题 → 用户回答 → 评估掌握程度 Generate question → User response → Evaluate mastery

多模态支持

Multi-modal Support

支持文本、文档、图片等多种输入方式，满足不同学习场景的需求。

Supports multiple input methods including text, documents, and images to meet the needs of different learning scenarios.

智能引导

Intelligent Guidance

通过苏格拉底提问法，让学生主动思考和探索，培养批判性思维。

Through the Socratic method, guide students to think and explore actively, cultivating critical thinking.
